name: Craig Herskowitz
bottom_line: A biography of a lawyer and two-time candidate. His election history checks out, including how narrowly he lost a 2025 county race; his government-service claims were not independently confirmed.
findings: He lost the 2024 State Senate race to Mario Mattera and the 2025 county legislature race to Stephanie Bontempi by about 300–400 votes.
page_issues: Career roles are listed without dates.
